title: Changelog Feed
description: Reusable, prop-driven changelog/whats-new section. Composes a header (eyebrow / title / subtitle) with a list of versioned entries grouped by kind (feature, fix, improvement, chore, breaking). Three visual layouts: timeline (vertical rail with date markers), cards (large shadcn Card per entry), list (minimal markdown-style with version/date headings). Pure server component — no client JS.
